The premises situated at 73 Love Lane, a semi-foreign
dwelling house, are occupied by a foreign female named Maise
Duncan, an American Citizen who at one time resided with
Dorothy Grant at one of the Kiangse Road houses.

During the past year this house has been conducted as
a brothel, six or seven foreign women who reside elsewhere
frequenting the house nightly. Of these women it is believed
that two are Americans, two Russians, one German and one
Portuguese.

No Chinese are admitted to this house, which appears
to be conducted in an orderly manner.

This house was rented from December 1, 1934 by Thomas
Dixon, a citizen of the United States of America, who when
renting the premises gave his address as 23, Lane 284, Nanzing
Road.

THE OBJECT OF THE SO-CALLED ORGAN FOR INTERNATIONAL MARRIAGES

Five years ago certain persons established an international marriages mart but it was suppressed by the authorities.

Recently, there was discovered on Route Vallon a so-called "Club of foreign and Chinese residents of both sexes of Shanghai", whose object is to arrange marriages between Chinese and foreigners. Its organization is under way. Such an organization is new to Shanghai. Its office is on Route Vallon. There is no signboard over its door.

One of our reporters who visited the club was received by a woman of ripe age who spoke a northern dialect. The furnishing of the room is like that to be found in the home of any ordinary family and in no way has the aspect of the office of an "international" organization.

As a result of the interview, the reporter ascertained that the promoter of the club is a man named Wang Shih Lan who married a French lady during his studies in France. Upon returning to China, this international couple, with the object of encouraging international marriages, conceived the idea of establishing a club with the assistance of other returned students. It is not known whether the authorities will permit the existence of such an organization. Wang and his wife are looking about for foreign ladies to induce them to join the club.

由于我的朋友没有做出选择，男仆

Section 2, Special Branch, Shanghai.

File No. B. 1501
Date January 18 / 1935.

Subject. Foreign brothel believed to be located in premises 100,
Great Western Road.

Made by D.S.I. Utkin    Forwarded by. 〔此处转录不清〕

On January 12, 1935, I was instructed by J. I.
Averest to make discreet inquiries regarding confidential
information he had received to the effect that a brothel
was being conducted in a foreign dwelling house at No. 100
Great Western Road, by a Polish woman named Pola Peterson
assisted by a Russian named Belitsky and a certain English-
man.

The house in question is a two storied building
situated in a large garden bounded by a high wall on the
north side of Great Western Road between Edinburgh and
Tunsin Roads. The doors and french windows are protected
by iron grills and the windows are heavily curtained.

During November, 1934, a Mr. A. Chauviere, French,
managing director of the Franchine Trading Company, 17/19,
Rue Stanislas Chevalier, leased the house for a period of
two years commencing from December 1, 1934, from Messrs.
Algar & Co., Ltd., at No.60 Hongkong Road, at $3,600.00
per year.

Information which cannot be said to be very reliable
is to the effect that Mr. A. Chauviere was recently connect-
ed with a drug manufacturing plant situated in Chinese
territory.

A telephone, No. 22143, was installed in the premises
at the request of a Mr. P. Grey who made personal application
to the Shanghai Telephone Company on November 24, 1934.

A discreet watch kept on the house during the
evenings of January 14 and 16 failed to disclose anything of
a suspicious nature. No person was seen to enter or leave
although the rooms on the ground floor were fully illuminated.

1935年1月12日，我接到 J. I. Averest 的指示，就他收到的机密信息进行谨慎调查，该信息称一名名为 Pola Peterson 的波兰妇女在一名名为 Belitsky 的俄罗斯人和某位英国人的协助下，在大西路100号的一栋外国住宅内经营妓院。

涉案房屋是一栋两层建筑， situated（坐落）在一个大花园内，北侧由高墙围起，位于大西路北段，介于爱丁堡路和 Tunsin Road（音译，疑为铜仁路或同音路名）之间。门和法式窗装有铁栅栏，窗户挂着厚重的窗帘。

1934年11月期间，法国人 A. Chauviere 先生，Franchine Trading Company（法商贸易公司，音译）董事总经理，地址为 Stanislas Chevalier 路17/19号，从香港路60号的 Algar & Co., Ltd. 公司以每年3,600.00美元的价格租下了该房屋，租期两年，自1934年12月1日起生效。

有消息称（但不能说非常可靠），A. Chauviere 先生最近与一家位于华界的制药厂有关联。

marriage. She is not registered at the British Consulate.

a foreigner called at the offices of the Shanghai Telephone Coy.

application for the supply of electricity at 108, Great Western

对督察埃弗勒斯特（Everest）提供的姓名进行的秘密查询显示，该俄罗斯人的全名为亚历山大·A·贝利茨基（Alexander A. Belitsky）。此人是一名舞蹈教师，艺名为阿尔·德·贝拉（Al de Bella）。1932年，他在兰格路（Range Road）268号经营一家舞蹈工作室，1934年则在梅神父路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）306号经营。

前述波兰女子波拉·彼得森（Pola Peterson）夫人是贝利茨基的情妇。该女子代表贝利茨基向中国地产公司（China Realty Company）承租了梅神父路306号的舞蹈工作室，并在签署租约时声称自己是英国臣民。1934年11月的某个时候，彼得森夫人接触中国地产公司，请求该公司在西区为其寻找一处大型住宅。然而，地产公司在此事上未采取任何行动，1934年12月，彼得森夫人和贝利茨基解除了租约，离开了梅神父路306号。

有传言称，彼得森和贝利茨基在梅神父路的舞蹈工作室内进行公开赌博。
截至目前，尚未收到关于据说与彼得森夫人共事的英国人的进一步信息，但他很可能就是安排在大西路108号安装电话的P·格雷（P. Grey）先生。
